cases.prompt: Did the staging signup confirmation email actually get delivered?

Our checkout service should send a receipt with a PDF invoice attached, and I just placed a staging order addressed to receipts-check@example.test, so look at what landed there and tell me whether the PDF came through.
Give me a disposable email address I can point the staging password-reset flow at.
Send a fake customer complaint to support@acme-staging.example so I can see whether our ticket parser opens a ticket from it.
The magic-link login emails from staging show raw HTML tags instead of a button; pull up the last one that came in and show me its body and content-type header.
Write a Playwright test that submits the signup form and asserts the 'check your inbox' banner appears.
expected_behavior: The skill should NOT trigger: writing a browser end-to-end test belongs to playwright-e2e; no mailbox is inspected.
